title: Spectra of electricity demand
summary: How the Fourier transform of a real, finite signal shows its cycles, how multiplying cycles creates sidebands, and how the record length and window decide what can be seen.

concepts.label: Electricity load
concepts.description: Germany's total consumption from the public grid, GW, hourly mean of quarter-hours.

facts.text: Energy-Charts publishes ENTSO-E load per country at 15-minute resolution.

children.label: Daily cycle
children.description: The 24-hour waveform of demand: night trough, morning ramp, midday plateau, evening peak.

children.label: Weekly envelope
children.description: The weekday/Saturday/Sunday change in the height of the daily cycle.

children.label: Holidays and weather
children.description: Irregular changes (public holidays, heat, cold) that are neither daily nor weekly.

concepts.label: Fourier spectrum
concepts.description: The amplitude of each frequency in the signal, from a discrete Fourier transform.

facts.text: The DFT of N samples resolves frequencies 1/(N·Δt) apart.

children.label: Harmonics
children.description: Lines at whole multiples of a cycle's frequency (1, 2, 3, 4 per day) that describe its non-sinusoidal shape.

children.label: Sidebands
children.description: Lines at k ± j/7 per day, the weekly envelope shifted to each daily harmonic.

facts.text: The modulation theorem: multiplying by cos(2πf₀t) shifts a spectrum by ±f₀.

children.label: Spectral leakage
children.description: Power spread away from a line into side lobes, by the finite record and its window.

children.label: Frequency resolution
children.description: The smallest separation 1/T at which two lines can be told apart in a record of length T.

concepts.label: Window function
concepts.description: A taper applied before the Fourier transform: it trades a wider main lobe for lower side lobes.

facts.text: The Hann window's first side lobe is −31.5 dB, the rectangular window's −13.3 dB.

children.label: Rectangular window
children.description: No taper: the narrowest lines, the highest side lobes.

children.label: Hann window
children.description: A raised cosine over the record.

concepts.label: Amplitude modulation
concepts.description: A carrier whose amplitude follows a slower signal; in radio the sidebands carry the message.

facts.text: An AM broadcast's sidebands sit at the carrier ± the audio frequencies.
